passages.title: Le matin de Julie
passages.blurb: A rushed morning, start to finish: present tense, reflexive verbs and the three families of article.

passages.title: Au marché
passages.blurb: A shopping list at the market: articles, quantities with de, and numbers up to a hundred.

passages.title: La chambre de Théo
passages.blurb: One small room, described from the window to under the bed: il y a, place prepositions, adjective agreement and possessives.

passages.title: Le week-end de Sarah
passages.blurb: A quiet Saturday that does not stay quiet: the passé composé with both auxiliaries, plus the connectors that order a story.

passages.title: Le message
passages.blurb: A text from an unknown number: the futur simple, the three ways of asking a question, and the whole ne … family.

passages.title: Chez le médecin
passages.blurb: A tired man, a waiting room and an awkward question: reflexive verbs, negation, object pronouns and il y a.

passages.title: Le dernier train
passages.blurb: A delayed night train, a father's old story, and a stranger who knew him. Imparfait against passé composé, and the four relative pronouns.

passages.title: La colocataire
passages.blurb: Two candidates for a spare room, one week of hesitation, and one phone call too late. Conditionnel, the three si-clauses, y and en, and comparatives.

passages.title: L'entretien
passages.blurb: A job interview conducted in two languages at once: what is said aloud, and what is thought. Subjunctive triggers, verbs with à and de, on and the passive, and register from soutenu to familier.

passages.title: La lettre de 1974
passages.blurb: An unsent letter in the bottom drawer, and a second handwriting at the foot of the last page. Plus-que-parfait, reported speech, participe présent, and lequel after prepositions.
